method: Chosen for delight: things users notice and tell others about, and visual choices people like. Each is a block with a manifest, tests and planted-defect proofs like every other block.

delighters.name: Undo anything
delighters.gives: Every action, not just text, can be undone for a while afterwards

studentAdvocate.from: history: undo as a new change, conflict-safe

delighters.name: Command palette
delighters.gives: One keystroke to search and run any action in the app

delighters.name: Ask your data
delighters.gives: Plain-language questions over your own records, answered with the records shown

delighters.name: Magic paste
delighters.gives: Paste an email, table or screenshot and the form fills itself

delighters.name: Import from anywhere
delighters.gives: Drop a spreadsheet; columns are matched and every row's problem is shown

delighters.name: Never lose work
delighters.gives: Drafts save as you type, on every form, across devices

delighters.name: Works offline
delighters.gives: Keep working without a connection; changes sync and merge when it returns

delighters.name: Who's here
delighters.gives: See who else is viewing or editing, live

delighters.name: Share a view
delighters.gives: A read-only link to exactly what you see, expiring when you choose

delighters.name: Explain this screen
delighters.gives: Help grounded in the generated docs for the screen you're on

delighters.name: Find a time
delighters.gives: One click finds a slot that works for everyone, from their calendars

delighters.name: Reminders that stop
delighters.gives: Reminders across email, text and calendar that stop the moment it's done

studentAdvocate.from: notify: Reminder stops when done or after its limit

delighters.name: Receipts
delighters.gives: A plain record after every important action of what happened and when

studentAdvocate.from: notify: a receipt for every send, hold and suppression

delighters.name: Why am I seeing this?
delighters.gives: Every automated decision explains itself on request

delighters.name: Your whole record
delighters.gives: Download or delete everything about you in one click

delighters.name: Pick up where you left off
delighters.gives: Recent items and the exact place you stopped, on any device

delighters.name: Smart defaults
delighters.gives: Forms remember sensible choices, so the common path is one click

delighters.name: Bulk edit with preview
delighters.gives: Change many records at once and see every change before it applies

delighters.name: Snooze
delighters.gives: Push any item away until a time you choose

delighters.name: Teaching empty states
delighters.gives: First run shows sample data and the next step, never a blank page

delighters.name: Speak instead of type
delighters.gives: Voice input on any field

delighters.name: Reading comfort

delighters.name: Your language

delighters.name: Progress you can feel
delighters.gives: Quiet milestones that show what's been done, not just what's left

delighters.name: Is it me or is it down?
delighters.gives: Live service status inside the app, so nobody wonders

visual.name: Light and dark modes
visual.gives: Follows the device or the person's choice, on every screen

visual.name: High contrast
visual.gives: A contrast mode that passes accessibility contrast checks on every screen

visual.name: Design languages
visual.gives: Switch the whole app between design languages from one token set: Material, Fluent, Carbon, Primer, GOV.UK-style and USWDS

visual.name: Layouts
visual.gives: Choose between sidebar, top navigation and compact layouts without changing any feature

visual.name: Density
visual.gives: Comfortable or compact spacing, per person

visual.name: Brand themes
visual.gives: An organisation's colours, type and logo applied from one file

visual.name: Personal settings
visual.gives: Each signed-in person picks their language, mode, palette, style, density and reading comfort, remembered on every device

visual.name: Styles
visual.gives: Fun but professional looks for the whole app: Paper, Studio, Midnight, Blueprint, Garden and Terminal, each a complete set of design tokens

visual.name: Palettes
visual.gives: Colour palettes such as Ocean, Forest, Ember, Slate and Lavender, plus palettes safe for each common kind of colour blindness

visualTests: every screen is rendered in every mode, layout and design language, and compared with the approved picture
every mode passes contrast checks on every screen
every feature's walks pass in every layout, so a layout can never hide a feature
every palette and style passes contrast checks in both light and dark mode before it can be offered
